chunks: And there is not one among you who will not reach it. [Your] Lord has made this incumbent on Himself.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says every person will 'visit' Hell?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted through the lens of *Zayl al-Zayl* (the removal of the removal), where the 'descent' is viewed as a temporary passage for all souls to experience the reality of divine justice before the final resurrection. It underscores the inevitability of God's decree (*Hattam*) while distinguishing between the temporary abode of the righteous and the eternal dwelling of the wicked, highlighting the transitional nature of the afterlife.
